text: Why do they always teach us that it's easy and evil to do what we want and that we need discipline to restrain ourselves? It's the hardest thing in the world--to do what we want. And it takes the greatest kind of courage. I mean, what we really want.
author: Ayn Rand

text: What would you do if you weren't afraid?
author: Sheryl Sandberg
source: Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead

text: I've learned that making a 'living' is not the same thing as 'making a life'.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Done is better than perfect.
author: Sheryl Sandberg
source: Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead

author: Confucius

author: Mahatma Gandhi

author: Albert Schweitzer

author: Confucius

author: Pablo Picasso

text: We work to become, not to acquire.
author: Elbert Hubbard

text: I know of no great men except those who have rendered great service to the human race.
author: Voltaire

text: It Takes as Much Energy to Wish as It Does to Plan.

text: There is no limit to what we, as women, can accomplish.

author: Caroline Myss

author: Diane Von Furstenberg
